messages:
hana (docs): Hi folks, I'm assembling a compact regions & localization update. Will add a table with endpoints, deployment modes, KMS support, and a short FAQ about data locality. Draft coming up.
vik (eng): Sounds good. For endpoints use api.us.redwood.ai, api.eu.redwood.ai, api.ap.redwood.ai. Note: eu-central-2 will be beta next quarter.
paula (legal): Use the approved line for public docs: "We may process or store customer data in the geographic region selected for your tenancy. Contractual data locality guarantees are available via enterprise agreements." Do not promise locality without Sales/DPA.
hana (docs): Copy; will paste verbatim. Adding a DPA footnote for EU-DE. Also adding an italicized note: "Private installs depend on customer network/KMS."
mike (product): Include a small migration checklist: update base URL, rotate API keys, reconfigure allowlist, and pin models if needed. Short bullets only.
vik (eng): KMS wrapping (hosted): us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-northeast-1. Dedicated supports customer-managed KMS; Private depends on customer setup. ap-southeast-1 dedicated is currently limited/beta.
hana (docs): Adding SDK snippets: Python & Node showing region param and tenant header. Quick example for Python: 
```python
from redwood import Client
client = Client(region="eu-west-1", api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_KEY"))
res = client.text.generate("hi")
```
paula (legal): Also add Sales contact blurb: "For contractual locality, contact your Sales rep or sales@redwood.ai." Approved.
ci-bot: PR 854 created by hana: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/854  checks queued.
hana (docs): Pushed. Tagging @vik for endpoint/KMS verification and @paula for legal sign-off. Will merge after reviewers OK.
vik (eng): Quick nit: link to /docs/performance for latency SLOs instead of hard numbers.
paula (legal): LGTM on the inserted sentence. I'll review PR for any other wording issues shortly.
hana (docs): Thanks all  marking this thread resolved unless reviewers raise blockers. :white_check_mark:
